test.summary: SPM - OKR - Creating Hyperlink type custom field
test.description:
Test verifies creation of a Number type custom field using the creation modal and its correct behavior across the application.

* Creating a Hyperlink type custom field 
* Verifying that the field appears in the Fields list
* Verifying that the field is visible in all relevant places:
** OKR Detail, Overview table, Side Panel, creation dialog, and tree view
* Verifying that the hyperlink value can be set during OKR creation
* Verifying that the value is saved correctly and displayed in all supported views
* Verifying that the custom field is available only for Key Result according to "Used in" configuration
* Verifying that the custom field is not visible for Strategic Theme and Objective in any view

rag.text:
Test: TC-6119 — SPM - OKR - Creating Hyperlink type custom field
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/SPM/OKR/TS-512 OKR - OKR module
Labels: spm-mikolaj-tc

Description:
Test verifies creation of a Number type custom field using the creation modal and its correct behavior across the application.

* Creating a Hyperlink type custom field 
* Verifying that the field appears in the Fields list
* Verifying that the field is visible in all relevant places:
** OKR Detail, Overview table, Side Panel, creation dialog, and tree view
* Verifying that the hyperlink value can be set during OKR creation
* Verifying that the value is saved correctly and displayed in all supported views
* Verifying that the custom field is available only for Key Result according to "Used in" configuration
* Verifying that the custom field is not visible for Strategic Theme and Objective in any view

Steps:
1. Navigate to OKR settings → Fields of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-6119 SPM - OKR - Creating Hyperlink type custom field
   Expected: Fields settings page is displayed.
2. Click on "Create new" button.
   Expected: "Create custom field" modal is displayed.
3. Type field name, select Hyperlink field type, select only "Key result" in the "Used in" section. Click Create button
   Data: * fieldName: Hyperlink field
   Expected: Field is successfully created. New field appears in the "Your custom fields" list.
Field name, type,  empty description and "Used in" values are displayed correctly
4. Open Overview → click Add → Create strategic theme
   Expected: Creation modal is displayed. Hyperlink field is not visible in the OKR creation modal
5. Enter strategic theme name, set period. Click Create
   Data: * stName: Strategic theme 1
* period: Y2026
   Expected: Strategic theme is created and visible in tree view. Hyperlink field is not visible in the right-side.
6. Click Add + button next to strategic theme and add objective
   Expected: Creation modal is displayed. Hyperlink field is not visible in the OKR creation modal
7. Enter objective name, set period. Click Create
   Data: * objectiveName: Objective 1
* period: Y2026
   Expected: Objective is created and visible in tree view. Hyperlink field is not visible in the right-side.
8. Click Add + button next to Objective and add Key result
   Expected: Creation modal is displayed. Hyperlink field is visible in the OKR creation modal
9. Type name and Period, navigate to Hyperlink field and click edit button
   Expected: Name and period is filled in. 
"Edit hyperlink" modal is displayed
10. Fill out label and link fields and click Save
   Data: * labelName: Link to Jenkins
* link:[https://ci.softwareplant.com/job/QA/job/PERSONAL/job/_JIRA_CLOUD/|https://ci.softwareplant.com/job/QA/job/PERSONAL/job/_JIRA_CLOUD/]
   Expected: Hyperlink field value is displayed
11. Click create
   Expected: Key-result is created and visible in tree view. Hyperlink field is visible in the right-side with correct value.
12. Open Overview and navigate to Hyperlink field
   Expected: Hyperlink field is visible in the Overview table for Key result with correct name and value. Fields are not displayed for Strategic Theme and Objective in Overview
13. Click on the grey area of the Strategic theme row
   Expected: Side panel is opened on the right side and displays details of the selected Strategic theme. Hyperlink field is not visible
14. Click on the grey area of the Objective row
   Expected: Side panel is opened on the right side and displays details of the selected Objective. Hyperlink field is not visible
15. Click on the grey area of the Key-result row
   Expected: Side panel is opened on the right side and displays details of the selected Key result. Hyperlink field is visible with correct name and value.
16. Open Strategic theme in the detail page and navigate to the Info section
   Expected: Detail page is opened. Hyperlink field is not visible
17. Open Objective in the detail page and navigate to the Info section
   Expected: Detail page is opened. Hyperlink field is not visible
18. Open Key-result in the detail page and navigate to the Info section
   Expected: Detail page is opened. Hyperlink field is visible with correct value
